newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans drop, August falls 30-cent limit.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans drop, August falls 30-cent limit.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures fell to the day's lows near the close and nearby August plunged the 30-cent-a-bushel daily trading limit on talk of a recent increase in the deliverable supply of soybeans in Chicago, traders said.
Spot July led the way down on talk the soybeans could be registered, then posted for delivery on the CBOT contracts.
Forecasts for rain this weekend in the U.S. Midwest also weighed on the market, the traders said.
At 1313 CDT, soybeans were 15-1/4 to 30 cents lower, with July down 29 at $7.82 per bushel and August was down 30 at $7.45-1/2.
